scientific_integrity: The mean and pair-state reduction are credited to Gusev (2014); only the second-moment formula and relative-dispersion consequence are asserted as the present contribution. Exact finite tests supplement an infinite algebraic proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Odd number of states, one specified opposite pair, independent uniform binary input; not even-state, all-state, or biased-input synchronization. Earlier equivalent variance formula under alternate terminology may exist.
title: Exact random-input pair-merging variance in odd Černý automata
